title: Deck tokens
rule: `applyCanvasDeck` (from `lib/canvas.js`) writes the `--aha-deck-*` tokens onto the deck element from the deck's ink, accent and background. Everything drawn inside the slide canvas reads these tokens, so one call inks the whole canvas for white and black ink, on a solid or a photo deck. Never hard-code a colour inside the canvas.
why: The canvas is a cross-origin iframe that cannot see the host theme, so the ladder and the container set are resolved on the deck itself. The components on the Components page (buttons, count, status line, stepper) are built on exactly these tokens.

sections.name: Ink ladder
sections.what: Eight aliases of the deck ink, each the ink at a fixed share, plus the surface (the opposite of the ink at 80%). Shown here on a light, a dark and a photo deck: each swatch reads the live token.
sections.useWhen: text, hairlines, hover and pressed fills and chip outlines drawn inside the slide canvas
sections.notFor: app screens outside the canvas (they use the product tokens) and the audience phone (applyDeck).

rules.label: Ink ladder
rules.value: `--aha-deck-ink-secondary` 76 · `-line` 24 · `-stroke-chip` 20 · `-stroke` 12 · `-fill-active` 16 · `-fill-hover` 12 · `-fill` 8, each the deck ink at that share; `--aha-deck-surface` the opposite at 80

sections.name: Deck containers and modals
sections.what: The one container model for every rounded rectangle on the canvas, written by applyCanvasDeck so it resolves for white and black ink: fill, a 1px stroke on the large container (the count container draws none), a dashed 1px stroke for an empty slot only, radius lg 12 / sm 8, padding sm 12 / md 20 / lg 32. A canvas modal (the presenter leaderboard popup) is a large container on the modal fill over the modal backdrop.
sections.useWhen: any panel, card, counter or modal drawn inside the slide canvas
sections.notFor: app screens outside the canvas (they use the product surfaces) and the audience phone (applyDeck).

rules.label: Container
rules.value: `--aha-deck-container-fill` (the ink at 8% on a solid deck, the frosted surface on a photo deck), `-stroke` (the ink at 20%, 1px), `-stroke-empty` (the ink at 24%, 1px dashed, an empty slot only), `-radius-lg` 12 / `-radius-sm` 8, `-padding-sm` 12 / `-md` 20 / `-lg` 32. The large container draws the 1px stroke (the small count container draws none); a dimmed container (a wrong option once the answer is revealed) dims its stroke with its content instead of keeping it at full strength

rules.label: Modal
rules.value: panel `--aha-deck-modal-fill` (the opposite of the ink at 92%: white under black ink, Deep Space under white ink, so the slide behind barely shows) with `backdrop-filter: blur(var(--aha-blur-md))`, `-container-stroke`, `-container-radius-lg`, `-container-padding-lg`; behind it `--aha-deck-modal-backdrop` (black 40%). Close to the presenter leaderboard popup: white 80% with dark text on a light deck, black 75% with white text on a dark one
